runtime.note: 后端、模型契约及前端资源来自启动时固定快照；任务数据与凭据独立使用原目录。Python依赖环境仍共用，不是完整依赖隔离。

checks: explicit pair required; opening panel reads no comparison automatically
actual API shows input expectation output differences, scope warning, and exact large integers
selection invalidates old response; unknown missing result not treated as equal or completed
multi-turn data refused rather than flattened
leaving page during request prevents late result from appearing
unsaved edits disable comparison without writing task
refresh resets explicit selection and does not dispatch comparison or writes

limitations: Explicit local single-turn comparison only; not a controlled quality experiment or automatic attribution.
Only recent 200 ordinary runs listed in UI; all original history preserved.
Same recorded conditions do not prove same published graph/model/live service context.
Known credential patterns and secret fields are withheld, not a general business-data privacy detector.
No automatic rerun, new evaluation, persisted comparison selection, cost comparison or full FR-41/T096 acceptance.
